feeds.title: Ed Zollars CPA's Blog
feeds.description: Ed Zollars is a CPA in practice in Phoenix, as well as a lecturer and author for Kaplan Financial Education's CPE group, speaking for state societies accounting firms, and businesses looking for updates and training in tax issues. This blog is where her online comments other than those on federal taxes will be found. She also put together a weekly podcast of sermons for Prince of Peace Lutheran Church in Phoenix, Arizona.

feeds.title: The Ambitious Bookkeeper Podcast
feeds.description: The Ambitious Bookkeeper podcast is for bookkeepers & accountants who are growing or aspiring to start their own business. Our mission is to elevate the bookkeeping profession by providing support and resources for new and experienced firm owners. We share actionable tips on running a successful bookkeeping business, tools and resources, plus guest expert interviews that will help you elevate your business. Where you can find us: Website: https://www.ambitiousbookkeeper.com BBA: https://www.ambitiousbookkeeper.com/bba Facebook: https://www.facebook...

feeds.title: KORE Accounting Solutions Blog
feeds.description: With over 25 years of accounting experience, proficiency with the leading Legal Practice Management solutions, expertise in Client Trust Accounting, and a future-focused approach, KORE Accounting Solutions works closely with their customers as part of their teams to help them run more efficiently, stay compliant, and achieve their goals. Explore the latest accounting trends, tax strategies, and financial insights on the Kore Accounting blog. Read their blogs for your accounting needs.

feeds.title: Master Accounting and Tax Service LLC Blog
feeds.description: Master Accounting and Tax Service, LLC strives to provide the client with quality accounting, tax, bookkeeping, and fractional CFO / controller services at an affordable cost and with the utmost integrity. They work with small businesses and enterprise-level companies in Phoenix, all over the state of Arizona and Southern California. They provide all of their clients with a secure, encrypted web portal to always have all historical tax documents at their fingertips and to provide them with a secure means to transfer information to them or receive information from them.

feeds.title: LBS Tax & Accounting Blog
feeds.description: At LBS Tax and Accounting, they handle Tax Returns, Delinquent Taxes, Liens, Levies, Installment Agreements, Small to Medium Sized Business Accounting, Income Tax Accounting and Sales Tax. As a leader among small business accountants and bookkeepers, they strategize with business owners on management and accounting decisions. Business decisions made today affect the taxes you may pay tomorrow. Their goal is to develop a tax plan where taxes are minimized and profits are maximized.

feeds.title: HBL CPAs Blog
feeds.description: HBL was started in 1973 with a commitment to provide excellent client service. But over the last 40 years, they have learned that providing excellent service isn't enough. Clients expect excellent service. They wanted to do better. And so the concept of being their clients' best partner and guide was developed. Their purpose is to deliver the highest value for their clients to help them achieve their vision by being their best guide and partner.

feeds.title: Arizona Tax Advisors
feeds.description: Arizona Tax Advisors was established with clients' needs and goals in mind. After seeing so many businesses and individuals struggling to know anything about their business or tax situation, they decided to take a better approach to accounting and tax advising. They take pride in educating clients, spending as much time as is needed with each client, and helping them to grow and succeed. From the beginners on exchanges to the advanced investors, they have experience in nearly everything.

feeds.title: H&H Accounting Services Blog
feeds.description: Family is important to H and H Accounting, which is why they would like to introduce you to theirs. They take the financial health and well-being of their clients seriously. Their team understands how much you have riding on your business and personal economic success because they're in the same boat. They are committed to helping tax filers and business owners sleep easier at night by bringing reliable clarity to some of the most complex issues facing individuals and businesses.

feeds.title: BeachFleischman Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1990, BeachFleischman is Arizona's largest locally-owned public accounting firm and one of the Top 200 largest CPA firms in the United States. They provide accounting, assurance, tax, and advisory services to entrepreneurs, organizations, and businesses. From handling sensitive documents to providing sound advice, their clients trust them to safeguard their financial interests and guide them to make informed decisions. They passionately believe in the power of collaboration and what it can accomplish.

feeds.title: Blake Oliver CPA Blog
feeds.description: Blake Oliver is a CPA who specializes in accounting technology, and co-host of The Accounting Podcast, the most popular podcast for accountants and bookkeepers. He founded Earmark CPE so listeners can earn continuing professional education credits for listening to his shows and many more accounting and tax podcasts. Go through his blog and learn more about the latest news and resources to help you thrive in a changing profession.

feeds.title: Hays Accounting LLC Blog
feeds.description: Cynthia Hays, CPA and owner of Hays Accounting LLC, has a knack for taking the worry out of the tax filing process for her small business clients in the greater Phoenix, AZ area. Since 2000, Cynthia and her team have been providing income tax preparation, accounting, and consulting for QuickBooks services to a variety of clients, including real estate professionals, service contractors, and clergy. Their mission is to be a Christ-centered CPA firm, run with integrity and quality, which helps their clients become financially responsible and ease their anxiety about tax and accounting issues.

feeds.title: Carol Smith CPA Blog
feeds.description: Carol Smith CPA firm is large enough to offer a full range of professional services at a fair price, but small enough to give you the individual attention that you deserve. They work with you on a personal level to determine the best solutions for your unique needs, then leverage their seasoned expertise to achieve the best possible results. Rest assured that when a need arises, their firm is ready and capable of handling everything for you so you can focus on what matters most to you.

feeds.title: Copper Ledger Blog
feeds.description: Copper Ledger avoids high-risk, high-reward schemes that promise short-term rewards in favor of focusing on the long-term interests of you, your family, and your business. Their tax planning is focused on protecting your interests/wealth and minimizing your audit risk. To deliver this promise, they require that all clients engage with them for tax planning. Their team will take care of preparing and filing all necessary federal and state income tax returns for personal and business.

feeds.title: Foster Financial CPA Blog
feeds.description: Foster Financial CPA is a boutique firm in Phoenix, AZ delivering quality and knowledgeable accounting, payroll, and taxation services to the small business sector. By combining the expertise, experience, and energy of their staff, each client receives close personal and professional attention. Their firm is responsive. Companies who choose their firm rely on competent advice and fast, accurate personnel. They provide total financial services to individuals, large and small businesses, and other agencies.

feeds.title: Cloud Friday Accounting Blog
feeds.description: Cloud Friday Accounting is a woman-owned full-service accounting firm to supports service-based business owners like yourself. They do this by helping you find assurance through accurate financial statements, guidance for any number that pops into your inbox, and time back in your businesses and therefore your lives. Their goal is to seamlessly integrate with you and your team because they know that they can be most effective and efficient when working together, building a sense of belonging, clearly and quickly communicating, and delivering without delay.
